findings.problem: Shallow waves traveled away from shore
findings.evidence: Shared coastal.ts phase uses negative time; crest direction, runup derivative and delayed wetness tests pass.

findings.problem: Diagnostic output was tone mapped/fogged and page cache restoration disposed the scene
findings.evidence: Conditional output transforms; world-space normals; real shadow mask; persisted pagehide pauses without disposal and pageshow resumes. Browser interaction validation remains pending.

findings.problem: Plants floated above or sank through rendered terrain
findings.evidence: ecology, plants, forest-floor, snags and rock bases now use renderedTerrainHeight; independent raycast test confirms the triangle interpolation. CPU contact fix only, appearance not accepted.

findings.evidence: Additional 238617/245645-triangle near GLBs retain every original-size leaf component and source trunk. Island near silhouette ~98% source coverage; syringa near still 19–24% below source coverage. Asset-only CPU diagnostics are not reference acceptance.

findings.problem: Opaque refraction capture applied fog twice and clipped HDR in the byte fallback
findings.evidence: Opaque capture temporarily disables Exp2 fog and applies shared .25 capture scale with x4 decode on byte target. Source composition checked; GPU color inspection remains T13.

findings.problem: Terrain/rock atlas blocked the main thread during construction
findings.evidence: A dedicated built worker generates the identical seeded atlas while texture loads run. artifacts/worker-cpu-check.json must verify exact SHA-256 equality; browser transfer remains unverified.

findings.evidence: Static full HDR+PCF material count is 16 (12 ground maps, habitat, cloud, environment, sun shadow). Any new ground texture needs packing or a new material split; GPU compile/performance still pending.
